summary: Receipt Wrangler is a self-hosted tool designed to help you manage and categorise your receipts. It incorporates artificial intelligence features to assist with processing your expense documents quickly and with minimal manual effort.
goodFor: It suits individuals or small teams wanting to organise their financial paperwork on their own hardware rather than relying on a commercial cloud service.
watchOut: The codebase has a modest community following and you should verify whether its specific AI capabilities depend on external third-party API keys or local models.
deployNotes: As a Docker-based application, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
